title: Refund Policy
subtitle: Please review the following information before enrolling in a course at Primeweb Dynamics.

sections.heading: 1. Introduction
content: This Refund Policy explains the general process for handling refund and cancellation requests related to courses offered by Primeweb Dynamics.
Students are encouraged to review the course details, fees and enrollment conditions before making a payment.

sections.heading: 2. Refund Eligibility
content: Refund eligibility will be determined according to the written refund terms communicated by Primeweb Dynamics at the time of enrollment.
The applicable refund conditions may depend on the course, enrollment status and services already provided.

sections.heading: 3. Cancellation Requests
content: Students who wish to cancel their enrollment should contact the Primeweb Dynamics team using the official contact details.
Please provide your registered name, contact number, course details and payment information when submitting a request.

sections.heading: 4. Refund Processing
content: Approved refunds will be processed according to the payment and refund conditions communicated to the student.
The refund processing timeline and any applicable deductions must be confirmed by the company before enrollment.

sections.heading: 5. Non-Refundable Charges
content: Any non-refundable fees, administrative charges or deductions must be clearly communicated to students before payment.

sections.heading: 6. Contact for Refund Requests
content: For refund-related questions or cancellation requests, please contact Primeweb Dynamics through the official contact details below.
